content:
maria: quick idea — run a low-tier routing policy that does probabilistic degrade + periodic probes instead of full deterministic fallback. goal: save token spend but detect quality regressions early.
ben: short: how would we pick probe rate? also need telemetry hooks.
sachin: thinking 90/10 default (cheap/expensive). probes are sticky per-user for 10m to avoid flapping. if probe fail rate > threshold we revert.
maria: exactly. check perf and semantic checks. we can use existing eval harness to score a small sample from probes.
anya: console UX: surface a "probe rate" slider and show live delta: tokens saved, p95 latency delta, and regression risk score. also allow per-region override.
lee: operationally we need per-tenant token budget guardrails too. if tenant sets monthly token budget, cheap variants should be preferred once burn rate exceeds X%. also need a hard token cap for hosted free tier.
ben: API debate: should routing hints be a header (x-redwood-routing-hint) or in-body param? header is nicer for proxies, body is explicit for SDKs. we also need a separate cost-hint header like x-redwood-cost-hint: low|normal|prefer-accuracy. thoughts?
sachin: prefer header for gateways. but validate in control plane. also we must ignore user-supplied hints for enterprise locked policies.
maria: config sketch (pseudo):
```
routePolicy: {
  defaultVariant: "cheap-q4",
  probeRate: 0.1,
  stickyWindowSecs: 600,
  perTenantBudgetBehavior: {thresholdPct:0.7, action:"prefer-cheap"}
}
```
ben: nice. what telemetry events do we emit?
anya: emit: route.variant_chosen, probe.sample_result(score), token.cost_per_request, user_feedback_event, rollback.triggered. show time-series in rollout card.
lee: also emit tenant.burn_rate and per-region capacity pressure so routing can consider region penalties.
ben: failure modes: cheap variant hallucination -> increased re-requests -> overall cost up. need to track regen rate and net token delta.
maria: agree. plan: 1) implement probe routing in runtime (feature flag), 2) add headers API (x-redwood-cost-hint), 3) wire telemetry + console rollout card with probe slider, 4) start internal canary at 5% for non-critical tenants.
sachin: small nit: make probe sample deterministic per-user id hash so we don't oversample bots.
ci-bot: buildkite: job #4721 passed — runtime/probe-routing feature-branch built and test-suite green :white_check_mark:
anya: action items: Maria to spec runtime flags, Ben to draft API header RFC, Sachin to implement sampling, Lee to add budget guardrail hooks, Anya to mock console card. target: internal canary next week.
maria: thanks — will drop a short RFC in #eng-platform and link here. :rocket:
